desc: With an aggressive TSP texture for positive weapon control, compatibility with optional Storage Cores for gear stowage, and a unique backstrap design for proper trigger finger placement, the K2 brings modern styling and ergonomics to the AK platform. It is a drop in upgrade for AK47/AK74 pistol grips. It features a unique backstrap shape for proper trigger finger placement, aggressive TSP texture (Trapezoidal Surface Projections) for positive weapon control in all environments, and includes a basic grip cap, but accepts optional Storage Cores for customized gear stowage.
